name: PIROXICAM 20 MG 20 CAPSULES
description: Piroxicam is used to relieve pain, tenderness, swelling, and stiffness caused by osteoarthritis (arthritis caused by wear and tear of the lining of the joints) and rheumatoid arthritis (arthritis caused by inflammation of the lining of the joints). If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
